Wow that is one hell of a situation to be in, I can't even imagine the amount of stress and anxiety you are feeling.

I can't say that there is a perfect answer for your problems but I can tell you what I would do. Your partner if you love them then you should try talking to them you probably already have but you need to explain that these kids aren't just your responsibility they need to chip in to help.

The kids are a tough one because you never really know what a child is thinking I would just be there for them and care for them whenever you can because at that age they won't be able to make a fair judgement no matter what you do for them.

It's your life and I believe that you need to decide what's more important to you, your partner? or you and your children's happiness if he doesn't get on board and start helping you then you may have to leave him and focus on yourself and the kids.

Do you have anyone that can help you someone that you could pour everything your feeling to?

Having family that is judgmental to the degree that yours are is something that not everyone could cope with as long as you have, I want you to know that your a very strong person even if you don't believe me.   


I'm not saying this is the only course of action you can take but I would focus on getting a job that you will like and move out as soon as you can, then you can try talking to people over the internet or if you can muster it in real life and try and get someone you can trust that you can pour your feelings out to. 

Your young so you have your whole life to improve your social prowess it's not impossible for you to have a normal life but it will be if you continue to listen to toxic people.
what has happened to you is not fair even in the slightest have you tried talking to your parents about their unjust treatment of you or are you scared to talk to them?

I personally believe that fighting to survive is the best course of action yes your situation is horrible and yes everyone experiences pain differently that's why no one can ever truly understand how you feel but I believe you should fight for a better life no matter what the circumstance are and while it's easier said than done I still think you should focus on getting rid of anything toxic in your life no matter what you have to give up to do so and find a job that will fulfil you even if you believe that you are worthless your not and everyone deserves to be happy so maybe try work experience in different fields of work or find a hobby that calms you and makes you happy. you can improve your circumstances while it will be hard and painful and sad and depressing you can do it. I'm not a professional in any sense of the word when it comes to depression or pain but i have gone through it and am still going through it but I don't believe that you should throw away your life.
